pages.text: Use Miniature Immortal Ruin as the template, Spirit Sword as the base and Spirit Core as the addition. Enchantments and tempering remain while durability refreshes.
It retains stage damage, Spirit Repair, self-cycling tempering and sword recall. If several supported swords are in the embedded furnace, recall chooses the most recently used.
Each tempering point grants 1.5% damage and sweep range is 50% wider than the Spirit Sword. Tempering still halves after a hit.

Use it to spend five Immortal Yuan and teleport targets in a 13x13x13 region one block in front of the wielder. Their velocity is cleared and they are restrained for one second. The config controls whether other players are affected.
